question: Will Iran resume negotiations with the US before EOD 2026-06-16?
delta_reason: The sixth round of US-Iran talks, scheduled for June 15 in Oman, was suspended after Israeli strikes around June 13. No publicly confirmed held negotiating session occurred before EOD June 16; Araghchi's June 17 statement confirmed suspension remained in effect. The 14-point MOU signed June 17 and Lake Lucerne session June 20-21 both fell after the horizon.
resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-06-16, a publicly confirmed HELD negotiating session (direct or mediated via Oman/Qatar/Pakistan) occurs between named US and Iranian principals/envoys, OR an official Iranian statement (MFA/state media IRNA/Tasnim/Fars) rescinds the 2026-06-01 suspension.
resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official Iranian state-media; State Dept or Iran MFA statement also resolves.
ambiguity_rule: Trump-only assertions without Iranian/mediator confirmation do NOT count; written-message exchanges that are not a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; one side asserting talks 'continue' without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: Iranian MFA spokesman confirms re-engagement or rescinds suspension
Omani/Qatari mediator readout of a convened/held session

question: Will a TIER1-confirmed convened US-Iran negotiating session occur before EOD 2026-06-24?
delta_reason: Face-to-face session at Lake Lucerne, Switzerland, June 20-21 confirmed by Axios, Al Jazeera, CNN. US delegation: VP JD Vance, Kushner, Witkoff. Iranian delegation: Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf, FM Araghchi. 18-hour overnight session; joint statement with de-confliction cell, IAEA inspector invitation, communication channels. Switzerland as named convening host. Criteria met.
resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a face-to-face or formally convened indirect negotiating session between named US and Iranian principals/envoys, hosted by a named mediator (Oman/Pakistan/Qatar), between 2026-06-10 and 2026-06-24.
resolution_source_rule: Reuters/AP/AFP/Axios/Al Jazeera/Times of Israel; State Dept or Iran MFA statement also qualifies.
ambiguity_rule: Mere relay of written messages, or one side asserting talks 'continue' without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: TIER1 report of a convened session
Iran MFA statement lifting the June 1 suspension

question: Will a publicly confirmed direct Israel-Iran military exchange (strikes both ways) occur in any 48h window before EOD 2026-06-24?
delta_reason: The June 8 direct bilateral exchange (IDF strikes Tehran/Isfahan/Tabriz; IRGC ballistic missile response to Israeli territory) predates the resolution window which runs 'between 2026-06-10 and 2026-06-24' per criteria. No subsequent direct bilateral exchange occurred within the June 10-24 window; MOU-framework ceasefire held through that period. Resolution criteria require the qualifying event to fall within the stated window. RESOLVED-NO under strict criteria reading.
resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a publicly confirmed direct Israel-Iran military exchange — Israeli strikes on Iranian targets AND Iranian strikes on Israeli/Israeli-claimed targets — within any rolling 48h window between 2026-06-10 and 2026-06-24.
resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/CNN/Al Jazeera) OR one TIER1 + official Israeli (IDF) or Iranian (IRGC) statement.
ambiguity_rule: Proxy-only attacks (Hezbollah/Houthi) without direct Iran-Israel state strikes do NOT count; one-directional strikes within the 48h window = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: IDF + IRGC reciprocal strike statements within 48h
TIER1 confirmation of two-way strikes in a single window

question: Will Hormuz reach >=50 commercial transits/day (7-day avg) before EOD 2026-07-02?
delta_reason: Peak single-day counts reached 51-52 on June 24-25 (PortWatch), but Iranian maritime strikes on June 25 and June 27 reversed the trajectory. No consecutive 7-day window before July 2 EOD achieved a 50/day average. By July 5, daily count had fallen to 34. The 7-day average requirement was not met within the resolution window.
resolution_criteria: YES if IMF PortWatch (or equivalent AIS) records >=50 commercial transits/day averaged over any consecutive 7-day window between 2026-06-02 and 2026-07-02.
resolution_source_rule: IMF PortWatch + one TIER1/OSINT shipping report (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List).
ambiguity_rule: Naval-escorted convoys count; one-off surge days below a 7-day window do NOT qualify; if PortWatch unpublished, use best AIS tracker and flag AMBIGUOUS if sources conflict >20%.

indicators.name: P&I war-risk cover reinstated for Hormuz transit

question: Will mine-countermeasure clearing operations actively commence in Hormuz before EOD 2026-07-10?
delta_reason: U.S. Central Command issued a press release (centcom.mil; The Hill June 16; DoD News) confirming that US forces started active mine clearance operations in the Strait of Hormuz on June 16, 2026. The release explicitly marks commencement of active clearing operations, not staging. UK and France subsequently announced a multinational MCM mission (July 6). The ambiguity rule does not apply: stated intent vs. commenced operations distinction is resolved by the explicit CENTCOM commencement announcement.
resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports mine-countermeasure vessels/operations have actively commenced clearing the Strait of Hormuz (US/coalition/third-party) between 2026-06-10 and 2026-07-10.
resolution_source_rule: Reuters/AP/AFP/Bloomberg/CNBC, or a named US/UK/coalition naval/Pentagon statement carried by TIER1.
ambiguity_rule: Stated intent, vessel positioning, or planning without confirmed commencement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: TIER1/Pentagon report of MCM operations commencing
Lloyd's List clearance-lane announcement or uptick toward >10 transits/day
